full_text:
Article 2 (Types of Certificates, etc.)
(1) The types of certificates issued by national schools of each level under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Education (hereinafter referred to as "schools") shall be as specified in the attached Table.
(2) Where necessary, a school may issue certificates other than those under paragraph (1) as prescribed by detailed enforcement rules under Article 3.
(3) Certificates under paragraphs (1) and (2) shall be issued without collecting any fee. Provided, however, that where any other statute or regulation mandatorily requires the collection of a fee, such fee shall be collected in accordance with the relevant statute or regulation.
